findings.PRJ-015: Bethesda Plugin Info 1.5.3 remains the coordinated compatibility target. Its current-host gate is real Windows MO2 v2.5.2 with exact column, tooltip, warning/category, drag/drop, theme/DPI, and restart proof; no runtime promotion was made without that evidence.
findings.PRJ-016: Bethesda Creations Version Tracker 2.4.3 remains the current target. Preserve the v2.3.1 migration away from per-mod.bethesda-creation-sorter.json sidecars, corrupt-marker quarantine, and user metadata while qualifying current Starfield/Creation behavior and the coordinated drag/column stack.
findings.PRJ-017: Current MO2 master installs a host ModListStyledItemDelegate that preserves separator indentation, background/marker painting, and readable text colors. Image Column 1.4.12 should compose with that delegate rather than replace the full list delegate. Preserve all multi-source media providers, stable mod identity, compact rows, complete off-screen availability, and no viewport caps. Add QAbstractItemModelTester only as a matching-version development harness when available, not a shipping dependency.
findings.PRJ-018: Current MO2 dragMoveEvent delegates semantic drag handling to QAbstractItemView after host-specific state handling, and ModList item flags define valid drop locations. Line Restorer 1.1.0 must remain rendering-only. Proposed a Host Drag Contract Recorder that compares accepted/proposed/drop action, drop indicator position, target index, item flags, and final mod order with the plugin disabled versus enabled.
findings.PRJ-019: Current MO2 ModListSortProxy uses dynamic sorting and invalidateFilter/filterInvalidated paths, while ModListView already coalesces one marker/plugin refresh burst with a single-shot timer. These are the exact host hot paths to instrument. Newer Qt beginFilterChange/endFilterChange APIs require Qt 6.9/6.10 and are forward-only candidates because MO2 v2.5.2 ships Qt 6.7.1. Preserve 4.0.1 exact-modList binding, reversible hooks, circuit breaker, full-list semantics, and no worker/polling shortcuts.

projectConstellationImprovement.name: Host Contract Lens
projectConstellationImprovement.goal: Derive a read-only per-project view of current host/runtime contracts such as exact host version, model/view/delegate/API assumptions, forward-only APIs, verification freshness, and the next real-runtime proof target.
projectConstellationImprovement.benefit: Makes host drift and version-incompatible proposals obvious without allowing the Project Constellation presentation layer to mutate project-owned verification authority.
projectConstellationImprovement.smallestExperiment: Generate the lens for the five MO2 projects from their current wiki evidence and host-source references, then verify that every displayed contract links back to project-owned or primary-source evidence.
projectConstellationImprovement.acceptance: No project record is removed or rewritten, all 63 projects remain available, stale/unverified evidence is visibly distinct, and the lens is derived-only.

researchDecisions.finding: Useful as an additive model-consistency checker when the recovered test environment exposes a matching QtTest binding.
researchDecisions.risk: QtTest version mismatch or accidental shipping dependency.
researchDecisions.acceptance: Runs only in development/CI, matches the qualified host Qt, and detects model/proxy consistency faults without changing runtime behavior.

researchDecisions.finding: Semantic trace comparison is stronger than screenshot-only verification for a visual-only drag indicator.
researchDecisions.risk: Instrumentation must observe rather than alter drag events.
researchDecisions.acceptance: Plugin-off and plugin-on semantic traces are identical for every deterministic drag fixture; only overlay-paint evidence differs.

researchDecisions.finding: Current Qt exposes more precise filter invalidation APIs, but they postdate the Qt 6.7.1 runtime shipped by stable MO2 v2.5.2.
researchDecisions.risk: Raising or diverging the host Qt requirement would break current compatibility.
researchDecisions.acceptance: Reconsider only when the actual MO2 host ships a sufficient Qt version and a same-dataset before/after test proves lower work with identical row mapping and state.
